summary: Completed comprehensive testing of LUIGGI HOME ERP features: Login authentication (success/failure), MV/ZC library despiece calculations, PDF factory reports, CM/MM toggle, and password verification. All 23 backend tests passed. Frontend UI tests verified login flow, CM/MM toggle functionality, and error handling.
critical_code_review_comments: Login.jsx correctly implements XMLHttpRequest for login to avoid 'body stream already read' issues
verify_password() in server.py supports bcrypt ($2b$/$2a$), SHA256 (64 hex chars), and plain text fallback
calculate_furniture_despiece() correctly handles MV prefixes (A, ASCE, B, BF, C, CH, etc.) and ZC prefixes (9A, 9B)
formatMeasure() in BudgetTable.jsx correctly multiplies by 10 for MM mode
factory_reports.py generates PDF with logo from global settings, order info, furniture list, and despiece
seed_data_creation: No seed data created - used existing products and user accounts
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested features tested and working: 1) Login auth with bcrypt/SHA256 support, 2) MV/ZC despiece calculations with correct component detection, 3) PDF factory reports with logo, 4) CM/MM toggle in BudgetTable (formatMeasure multiplies by 10 for MM), 5) Password verification supports multiple hash formats. DESPIECE button requires canViewTechnicalDespiece permission.

8_despiece_fregadero.details: Fregadero (sink) cabinets correctly exclude TAPA-S and include TRAV-F/TRAV-T

10_pdf_report_endpoint.details: Endpoint exists and returns 404 for non-existent orders

12_format_measure_function.details: formatMeasure() returns value as-is for CM, multiplies by 10 for MM

budget_table.cm_mm_toggle: UNIDAD MEDIDAS section with CM/MM switch - FOUND
